text: 据快科技，全球存储芯片巨头美光在中国台湾的工会组织，正以韩国同业的前车之鉴为蓝本，酝酿一场可能撼动DRAM供应链的工业行动。据悉，美光台湾工会已就现行的绩效奖金封顶制度召开多场说明会，并明确将三星电子工会今年通过罢工成功取消奖金上限的案例列为参照模板。 工会在发给员工的讯息中发出质疑，公司营收以三位数百分比暴增、毛利率逼近历史峰值，<u>但基层奖金却受限于“薪酬两倍即封顶、且超额不得连发五月”的陈旧框架</u>，这一反差已令内部不满情绪持续累积。截至目前，美光官方未就工会的罢工威胁作出任何公开回应。 产业观察家指出，美光面临的棋局比三星更险：中国台湾厂区
text_en: Per Kuai Technology, global memory chip giant Micron's labor union in Taiwan is brewing industrial action that could shake DRAM supply chain, modeled on Korean peers' precedent. Micron Taiwan union has held multiple briefings on current bonus cap system and explicitly cites Samsung Electronics union's strike this year successfully removing bonus cap as reference template. The union questioned in employee messages: company revenue surging triple digits, gross margin near historical peak, but grassroots bonuses constrained by "two-times salary cap with no overage for five consecutive months" outdated framework, fueling rising internal dissatisfaction. To date, Micron has made no public response to union strike threats. Industry observers note Micron faces a tougher position than Samsung: Taiwan plants
